items.name: Fatou
items.quote: I used to write down unpaid orders in a notebook. Now Boutik tells me who to follow up with every morning.

items.name: Ibrahima

items.name: Awa
items.quote: My clients order straight from WhatsApp, I don't need a separate website anymore.

items.question: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
items.answer: No. Boutik opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message, you just hit send. No Meta Business verification required.

items.question: Is Boutik free?
items.answer: Yes, the Free plan lets you try Boutik on your shop. Move to a paid plan only when you want more catalogues or automatic reminders.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, no commitment. Change or stop your plan whenever you want from your account.

items.question: Is my client data safe?
items.answer: Your data and your clients' data stay tied to your account only and are never shared.

items.question: How do I pay for my subscription?
items.answer: By card (Stripe) or Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN, Wave...). Mobile Money payments cover 30 days and renew manually.

items.question: Which countries does it work in?
items.answer: Boutik works anywhere WhatsApp does. Pick your display currency (FCFA, Naira, Cedi, Dirham, Euro...) from your account.

items.question: What happens if I go over my plan's limit?
items.answer: The Free plan lets you generate 1 catalogue per month. Move to Essentiel or Pro for more catalogues and automatic reminders.
